_readme: Author-editable switches the routines read at the start of every lap. Change a value, commit to auto/dev, and the next lap obeys. Model and cadence are NOT here: they live on the routine itself (https://claude.ai/code/routines) because the repository cannot change what runs it; see docs/auto/CHARTER.md section 10.

_review_options.self: the building agent runs hate + sip on its own work, then the gates. Cheapest; weakest independence.
_review_options.subagent: after building and before pushing, the lap spawns a fresh reviewer agent that has NOT seen the work being made; it reads only the diff and the claims, runs hate + factchk + mandela, and can block the push. Default.
_review_options.critic-only: no per-lap review beyond gates; the daily critic routine is the only independent reviewer.

sprint._readme: The author asked for all primary work to land inside this window, with laps as close together as the platform allows. After `end`, a lap writes a one-paragraph 'sprint over' report and exits without building; the one-time handover routine writes the post-sprint list. The author pauses the routines on claude.ai/code/routines afterwards.
